forum.title: STM32CubeCLT 1.22.0 released
forum.best_answer_content:
This is an announcement post, if you have any issue or feedback to report please use the main page:

[STM32CubeIDE (MCUs) | STM32 MCUs Software development tools | Community](https://community.st.com/stm32cubeide-mcus-28)
forum.content_text:
**We are pleased to announce that STM32CubeCLT 1.22.0 release is now available**

**What is new in 1.22.0:**

* Updated to align with STM32CubeIDE v2.2.0

* Updated STM32CubeProgrammer to version 2.23.0

* Updated ST-LINK GDB server to version 7.14.0

* Updated JRE™ to version 21.0.10+7

* Updated STARM-Clang to version 21.1.1+st.7

* Updated Ninja to version 1.13.2

* Updated CMake to version 4.3.1

* Added support for make 4.4.1\_st\_20260330-0700

**Main fixed issues in 1.22.0:**

* Refer to the following Link [here](https://wiki.st.com/stm32mcu/wiki/STM32CubeIDE:STM32CubeIDE_errata_2.2.x#STM32CubeCLT_issues)

**Know problems and limitations in 1.22.0:**

* Refer to the following Link [here](https://wiki.st.com/stm32mcu/wiki/STM32CubeIDE:STM32CubeIDE_errata_2.2.x#STM32CubeCLT_issues)

**How to get STM32CubeCLT 1.22.0:**

* Download STM32CubeCLT 1.22.0  from  [here](https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/stm32cubeclt.html)
